name: Waka
source: The older of the two evil gods, she is more skilled in magic. She originally wanted to eat Ryouga to restore her strength, but changed her mind after Ryouga offered her food. She and her sister challenged the Amatsu gods in ancient times and were defeated, thus being sealed.
